scope: Research followed by user-authorized disposable testing of the two free candidates; no replacement adopted in the product.
linux_effect_to_preserve: Panel and shortcuts launch selected native applications with persistent private profiles.
The app and descendants are confined to a loopback-only network namespace, with a brokered local proxy path.
Unsupported direct IPv4/IPv6/UDP and ordinary DNS egress have no namespace uplink.
Unselected applications keep their network access; no system proxy, adapter DNS or default-route changes.
YAML/node selection stays with the existing Mihomo integration.
important_distinction: Per-application forwarding does not by itself establish the existing containment and failure-blocking guarantees. Driver/service installation is a deployment cost; runtime CPU/memory and developer effort must be assessed separately.

candidates.name: Sandboxie Plus + WFP + Mihomo
candidates.category: Application sandbox plus per-sandbox network rules
candidates.recommendation: First bounded evaluation candidate for preserving private application state, tracked descendants and kernel-enforced proxy-only network policy. This is an engineering recommendation, not validated feasibility.
documented: WFP callouts apply sandbox rules to tracked processes at IPv4/IPv6 ALE connect/accept layers.
NetworkAccess unmatched traffic is allowed unless an applicable broad block is configured.
WFP is available in the free edition. Proxy injection and DNS filtering require advanced paid features.
Proxy injection supports SOCKS5 TCP CONNECT, not HTTP proxies or UDP relay.
Valid selected proxy failures do not retry the destination directly, but invalid proxy configuration can disable proxying; independent WFP restrictions are needed.
NetworkProxyResolveHostnames is not enabled in standard builds; proxy injection is not a remote-DNS guarantee.
required_validation: Actual browser and child process operation.
Native DNS capture and prevention independent of proxy forwarding.
Proxy/configuration/service failure behavior and unchanged networking for unselected applications.
candidates.deployment: Administrator installation of kernel driver and service; fee depends on features used. Actual experience and performance unmeasured for this project.

candidates.name: InterceptSuite/ProxyBridge
candidates.category: WinDivert packet interception and transparent proxy relay
candidates.recommendation: Possible forwarding component; stock behavior is insufficient as the existing Linux-equivalent containment boundary.
documented_or_source_observed: TCP/UDP and IPv4/IPv6 forwarding, HTTP/SOCKS proxy support.
Version 4.1 uses privileged engine service and ordinary-user GUI after installer setup.
Rules return DIRECT when owner PID/name is unresolved or proxy configuration is absent/invalid.
A UDP PROXY rule using an HTTP proxy returns DIRECT.
DNS domain forwarding uses a snooped IP-to-domain answer cache; forwarding a domain does not prove the initial local DNS request was prevented.
Rules match executable names/paths; automatic isolated process-tree identity is not established.
candidates.license: MIT for project; WinDivert is a separate licensed dependency.

candidates.name: ProxiFyre + Windows Packet Filter
candidates.recommendation: Useful existing per-app forwarding comparison; not a stock containment replacement.
documented: TCP/UDP and IPv4/IPv6; app name/path rules and Windows service.
Fragmented IPv6 datagrams are passed directly, a documented bypass.
Limited unelevated mode uses best-effort attribution and unidentified-owner traffic remains direct.
Installer adds program-specific TCP/UDP inbound firewall rules.
candidates.license: Project AGPLv3; Windows Packet Filter licensing is separate. Redistribution requires review of the applicable vendor terms.

candidates.name: Proxifier / NetDetour
candidates.recommendation: Useful ready-made user-experience comparison; not open-source embeddable containment.
documented: Per-application TCP rules and remote name resolution.
Unsupported UDP must be blocked separately to avoid bypass; NetDetour explicitly documents a browser UDP-block rule.
NetDetour has an experimental WFP mode and configuration CLI; Proxifier offers standard and more limited portable editions.
unproven: Equivalent process-tree isolation, crash-blocking behavior, and broad application/native DNS containment in this project.

candidates.name: Custom WFP callout / commercial NetFilter SDK
candidates.category: Kernel connection filtering and redirection with user-mode relay
candidates.recommendation: Longer-term control over product semantics; highest development, signing and compatibility burden. Runtime overhead is not established by development complexity.
documented: Microsoft supports ALE connection/bind redirection through callout drivers.
TCP and UDP have distinct redirect/relay handling.
Default denial, process identity/lifetime, DNS handling, service-failure behavior, installation and rollback remain product responsibilities.

candidates.name: Classic AppContainer/LPAC + Job + broker
candidates.recommendation: A plausible research alternative to PSEC, but not a proven shortcut. Need actual same-container loopback, DNS and desktop compatibility checks.

lower_priority_routes.name: Whole-host TUN via Mihomo/sing-box
lower_priority_routes.reason: Common auto-route/DNS modes change host routing or DNS handling, which conflicts with the current no-host-network-reconfiguration goal.

lower_priority_routes.name: Windows Sandbox/full VM
lower_priority_routes.reason: Separate guest desktop/kernel and application installation/state changes; Sandbox is disposable and unavailable on Home. Different product experience.

lower_priority_routes.name: WSL2/WSLg
lower_priority_routes.reason: Runs Linux GUI applications; invoking a Windows executable does not confine that Windows process inside the Linux network namespace.

cross_cutting_dns_risk.finding: Ordinary Windows name resolution can be performed by the DNS Client service, so packet attribution to the originating app cannot be assumed. Sending a hostname onward to SOCKS is not proof that an initial local lookup was prevented.

preference_pending: One-time administrator deployment preference remains unanswered. User has authorized disposable testing, with final deployment simplicity mandatory.
recommended_next_step: Actually run both free candidates and compare observed network guarantees and deployment steps before adoption.

user_budget_requirement.mandatory: Free implementation; no required paid software, paid certificates or commercial SDK licenses.
user_budget_requirement.administrator_installation_preference: Disposable test installation authorized; final deployment UX must remain simple and is not preaccepted.

free_only_shortlist.name: Sandboxie free base features + free WFP + existing application proxy adapters + Mihomo
free_only_shortlist.status: First bounded validation candidate only. Do not depend on paid Proxy Injection, DNS Filtering or paid box modes.
free_only_shortlist.dns_evidence: Official Templates.ini includes a default OpenIpcPath for the DNSResolver RPC object. Closing that exact IPC object is a source-grounded free diagnostic candidate, not a verified comprehensive DNS policy. BlockDNS template only denies direct UDP/53.
requirements_unproven: Native DNS confinement and remote proxy resolution.
Direct IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP denial and stopped/invalid proxy behavior.

free_only_shortlist.name: ProxyBridge + official prebuilt signed WinDivert + Mihomo
free_only_shortlist.status: Zero-license-fee forwarding candidate; requires observed direct-routing gaps to be addressed before containment equivalence can be claimed.
free_only_shortlist.license: MIT project plus separately applicable LGPLv3/GPLv2 WinDivert obligations. No paid custom-driver signing is assumed when using unmodified official signed driver binaries.

free_only_shortlist.name: ProxiFyre + Windows Packet Filter personal/non-commercial edition
free_only_shortlist.status: Free for the vendor-declared personal/academic/noncommercial/evaluation scope, with documented bypass limitations; do not assume the free driver has unrestricted redistribution rights.

excluded_under_free_requirement: Required Sandboxie paid Proxy Injection or DNS Filtering features
Any implementation that requires purchasing a custom-driver signing/distribution service

candidates: free Sandboxie + free WFP + existing app proxy adapters + Mihomo
